policy: RBI overnight VRRR liquidity auction under LAF
what: The RBI decided to conduct a ₹50,000 crore overnight Variable Rate Reverse Repo auction on November 18, 2026.
who_benefits: Banks with surplus liquidity parked under the reverse repo

policy: SGB 2020-21 Series VIII premature redemption
what: The RBI announced the premature redemption date and price basis for SGB 2020-21 Series VIII under the Government of India's Sovereign Gold Bond scheme.
who_benefits: Bond holders redeeming at gold-linked prices; limited listed-company impact

policy: SGB 2020-21 Series VIII premature redemption
what: The RBI set the premature redemption date and redemption price (simple average of gold prices) for SGB 2020-21 Series VIII under the Government of India's notification.
who_benefits: Bond holders redeeming at gold-linked prices; limited listed-company impact

policy: State Government Securities auction, November 17
what: The RBI held a state government securities auction for Andhra Pradesh, Goa, Karnataka and Madhya Pradesh, notifying ₹4,100 crore in total.
who_benefits: Banks and primary dealers bidding for state bonds

policy: RBI directive extension for Nagar Sahakari Bank
what: The RBI extended its Section 35A directions on Nagar Sahakari Bank Ltd., Etawah, beyond November 18, 2026, in the public interest.
timeline: Extended beyond close of business November 18, 2026
who_benefits: Depositors and co-operative banks; restrictive for the bank itself

policy: State Government Securities yield auction results
what: The RBI reported cut-off yields and accepted amounts for state bond re-issues by Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka and Madhya Pradesh, with Goa's allocation unaccepted.
who_benefits: Banks and primary dealers bidding for state bonds

policy: GETCO 220 kV transmission line reconductoring order
what: Gujarat's utility GETCO awarded a ₹130.49 crore contract to Advait Energy Transitions to reconductor two 220 kV lines.
who_benefits: Transmission EPC contractors and conductor suppliers

policy: Quad critical minerals deals
what: At the Quad Leaders' Summit in Manila, the leaders of the US, India, Japan and Australia announced landmark critical minerals deals to reduce dependence on foreign suppliers.
who_benefits: Critical minerals miners and processors outside China

policy: Proposed Delhi–Guwahati bullet train corridor
what: A 1,500-km bullet train corridor through Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, West Bengal and Assam, with five Bihar stations, has been proposed.
who_benefits: Rail infrastructure, civil construction and rolling-stock suppliers

policy: India-US trade deal signing
what: USISPF's Mukesh Aghi says a signing of the India-US trade deal could happen during PM Modi's Florida visit.
who_benefits: Exporters and firms exposed to US tariff and market access terms

source: search: disinvestment privatisation government stake sale
policy: IDBI Bank strategic disinvestment
what: DIPAM Secretary says the government's IDBI Bank disinvestment is likely to be completed by March 2027.
who_benefits: Prospective buyers of the government stake in IDBI Bank

policy: Specialty steel PLI scheme approval
what: Government approved Vajra Alloys, a subsidiary of Krishca Strapping Solutions, under the specialty steel PLI scheme.
who_benefits: Specialty steel and superalloy makers gaining PLI incentives

policy: NH-167 four-laning in Telangana
what: Union Cabinet cleared Rs 3,175.08 crore to widen NH-167 to four lanes in Telangana.
who_benefits: Road construction and infrastructure contractors

policy: Coal gasification scheme first round
what: Government reports seven applications received in the first round of the Rs 37,500 crore coal gasification scheme.
who_benefits: Coal gasification project developers and coal miners

policy: Transfer of Cambay offshore block to ONGC
what: The government rejected Vedanta's contract extension and transferred the producing Cambay offshore block to ONGC.
who_benefits: ONGC gains the producing block; Vedanta loses it

source: search: India data centre capacity announcement
policy: India joins US-led AI supply chain alliance
what: The Indian government joined a US-led alliance on AI and semiconductor supply chains.
who_benefits: Indian AI, semiconductor and electronics supply-chain firms

policy: Ministry of Defence naval hydrophone calibration order
what: The Ministry of Defence awarded Digilogic Systems a Rs 5.04 crore order for a Naval Hydrophone Calibration System.
who_benefits: Digilogic Systems, a defence electronics supplier

policy: Lithium and nickel processing subsidy scheme
what: The government opened bids for a Rs 2,814 crore subsidy scheme for lithium and nickel processing to cut import dependence.
who_benefits: Domestic lithium and nickel processing firms bidding for subsidy

policy: IDBI Bank disinvestment and transfer of control to Fairfax
what: The government and LIC are pursuing a proposed transfer of IDBI Bank control to Fairfax, which bank unions oppose and ask RBI to block.
who_benefits: Fairfax gains control; IDBI Bank and LIC shareholders exposed to outcome

policy: EU anti-dumping duties on steel imports
what: The European Commission imposed anti-dumping duties of up to 9.5% on steel imports from five countries, including India.
who_benefits: Indian steelmakers exporting to the EU face higher duties (negative)

policy: Review of LTCG tax and STT rationalisation
what: The government is examining suggestions to rationalise long-term capital gains tax and STT, with CBDT saying a final decision will come on February 1.
who_benefits: Equity investors and brokers exposed to any change in capital gains tax
